params.content:
Build a detox & liver support supplement line with proven formulations.

Detox is one of the most active wellness conversations, especially among customers focused on metabolic health, post-illness recovery, and environmental exposure. The category rewards brands with credible, science-backed positioning rather than gimmicky cleanses.

With direct access to over 190 doctor-formulated supplements, low minimums, and no set-up fees, you can build out a complete product line that fits your audience. Choose from our catalog of ready-to-launch formulations, customize the branding, and we provide and fulfill.

params.headline: Ready to launch your detox & liver support supplement line?

params.title: Reach Out to Get Your Detox & Liver Supplement Line Started

items.answer: Private labeling means you launch a detox and liver support product under your own brand using one of our pre-existing, doctor-formulated stock formulas. We handle production, quality testing, and bottling. You select the formulation from our catalog, design your label, and we produce the finished product ready to ship under your brand. No formulation work, no setup fees, no lab build-out.
items.question: What does private labeling detox and liver support supplements actually involve?

items.answer: Most detox and liver support formulations have minimum order quantities in the low hundreds of bottles per SKU. Once your labels are approved, production typically takes three to four weeks before your first inventory ships. Custom packaging or formulation can extend that timeline. We give you exact MOQs and lead times for the SKUs you select during your consultation.
items.question: What are typical minimums and lead times for detox and liver support products?

items.answer: Yes. All our detox and liver support formulations are produced in our FDA-registered, GMP-certified Vermont facility. Our formulations meet dietary supplement labeling requirements under DSHEA. Each batch is tested for identity, potency, and contaminants. You receive Certificates of Analysis with your inventory. We help you understand the structure-function claims you can responsibly make on your label.
items.question: Are these detox and liver support products FDA-compliant?

items.answer: Total launch cost depends on the SKUs you choose, the packaging you select, and the volume you order. Most clients launch a 3-5 SKU detox and liver support line for under $15,000 in initial inventory, including custom label design. There are no setup fees, no annual contracts, and no formulation costs for private label. We provide transparent SKU-by-SKU pricing during your consultation.
